description: An OpenStreetMap node tagged historic=aircraft inside the grounds of Queen Beatrix International Airport; reverse-geocoded to the airport itself. The node carries no name; no type and no photograph; and no other source consulted mentions a displayed airframe on Aruba. The airport's wartime name was Dakota Field. Recorded because an airframe-level node inside an international airport is a far stronger prior than an unnamed node in open country; but a single untyped node is the whole of the evidence
museum_name: Queen Beatrix International Airport Aircraft Display -- Oranjestad
